records.subject: spec-guard-claude
evidence: command:claude plugin marketplace update spec-guard-marketplace && claude plugin update spec-guard@spec-guard-marketplace

result:updated from 0.68.0 to 0.69.0; installed_plugins.json records gitCommitSha 0236e0e (the tag); the installed plugin directory is identical to the release asset apart from the runtime .in_use marker

result:a new claude -p session in a temporary project with .epiq/project.json got the read-back sentence from SessionStart:startup in hook_additional_context; an interactive session driven through tmux ran /clear and SessionStart:clear delivered the same sentence into the context

result:real sessions with a local-only ledger (sonnet): the mid-task message from another session was NOT recorded in the ledger in 2 of 2 runs (the agent only ran the read-back listing and said it would wait); a new session told only to carry on listed the waiting-on-* issues, found the held item and its reply target, did not send to the absent recipient and left the delivery date to the user

not-verified:the read-back listing calls omitted repoRoot; every such call in these runs resolved to the right project, and none was observed answering for a different one; the risk is the one the ticket skill records (Claude's user-level MCP process may not start in the session directory), so a follow-up should state repoRoot in the reminder (corrected in 0.70.1: this line first said the wrong-project case had been observed in the maintainer session, which was not so)
